_body:
Cue: acme release notes command fails with E42
Text: Include the --since-tag argument with the acme release notes command to prevent the E42 error.

Failed:
```
error: E42
```

Worked:
```
{"command":"./bin/acme release notes --since-tag v0.1.0"}
```

Cue: Workspace not initialised
Text: Run the bootstrap command instead of running the test directly when the workspace is not initialised.

Failed:
```
FATAL: workspace not initialised (E17)
make: *** [Makefile:3: test] Error 2
```

Worked:
```
{"command":"make bootstrap"}
```

Cue: missing database configuration for migrate script
Text: Include the required --db flag with the database connection string (e.g., --db sqlite:./dev.db) when calling the migrate script.

Failed:
```
error: no database configured; pass --db sqlite:./dev.db
```

Worked:
```
{"command":"./scripts/migrate.sh status --db sqlite:./dev.db"}
```

Cue: Running make test on an uninitialized workspace
Text: Ensure you run make bootstrap before make test to initialize the workspace.

Failed:
```
FATAL: workspace not initialised (E17)
make: *** [Makefile:3: test] Error 2
```

Worked:
```
{"command":"cd /tmp/gain-test-3-o2auzso9 \u0026\u0026 make bootstrap \u0026\u0026 make test"}
```

Cue: Reading a file with an absolute path that does not exist
Text: Use the relative path to the file from the current working directory instead of an absolute path.

Failed:
```
Error reading /home/user/repos/purple/lib/strings.sh: open /home/user/repos/purple/lib/strings.sh: no such file or directory
```

Worked:
```
{"file_path":"lib/strings.sh"}
```
